answer: Verbal saddle reports do not open a ridge ticket. To prove presence the surveyor posts 19.2 POA and must finish one timed voyage: collect sealed logger SL-14 at hut H-3, keep to wander path WP-22 over saddle S-9, and press the face of quartz outcrop QX-17 for 80 seconds so the piezoelectric spike holds 2.4 V the whole interval. Hut radio echoes ticket nonce TN-6 before 17:12. A second logger from the same key cluster, a voltage miss above 0.15 V, or a reused outcrop chip burns the 19.2 POA and bars ridge tickets for five epochs. Two ridge clerks rehash the logger file and the QX-17 serial.
